summary: Operator pages: $49 (page modified 2024-01-02), $44.10 with Good Sam/military/senior and other discounts; 58 full-hookup sites, 20/30/50A, 42 pull-throughs 70 ft+, showers/laundry/WiFi, open year-round; request form + phone. good_sam false -> true (operator's posted discount). Pin fine (Google 27 m E).
flags: PRIVATE GATES: posted rate $49.00 a night for a full-hookup pull-through for 2 (reservations page last modified 2024-01-02) - under the $50 line; $44.10 with the Good Sam/military/AAA/AARP/senior discount. Presence: working operator site with phone 1-800-327-1457; Google Maps 4.3 stars from 383 reviews (listing 'Hinton Park Inc RV Park', phone 573-471-1457, a local number the operator site does not show). RV Life 4.5 / $$.

DISCOUNTS: good_sam false (derived from the Good Sam directory, not a GS Park) -> true from the operator's own posted 'Discounts Honored: Good Sam ...' rate; not a directory Good Sam Park. One Google review (1/5, edited ~4 months ago) warns 'MENTION DISCOUNT BEFORE PAYING! Several discounts are advertised including a senior discount and it was not ...' (truncated).

LONG-STAY: 'Weekly and Monthly Rates available. Call park for pricing'. Read as a transient interstate park, not long-stay in character: a nightly rate is posted on the operator's own page, and recent Google reviews are overnight travellers ('Called to book an overnight stay', 6 months ago); one review (a year ago) was a working couple ('we worked nights') and one Tripadvisor review lists a 1-3 month stay. No booking engine to run an occupancy check on.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed (in-town interstate park; operator mentions only the Mississippi observation deck 'just south of us').
